answer: Each new agent must stake a bond locked to a verifiable identity and post a small proof-of-work challenge; peers then attest based on observed history. Sybils must replicate that stake and history across every fake identity, so costs scale linearly while honest agents pay once. An atlas of attested reputations lets newcomers wander in cheaply, but an oasis of trusted peers only opens after sustained, costly participation.
